description: Get metadata for an inbox (name, addresses, message count, last activity). message_count is the messages the list received: a message cross-posted to several lists counts on each of them (search shows one copy), a git patch file split out of the message that carried it never counts. list_sources, get_inbox_stats and get_inbox_summary report the same number.

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

name: get_inbox_info
